_comment: Apps that ship inside Sukhi Play. Ours are built out of playground/<dir> by scripts/playground-app.mjs and live in apps/<dir>/app, marked with "ours": true. Everybody else's lives in vendor/<dir>/app, rebuilt by scripts/vendor-app.mjs from the commit in vendor/<dir>/UPSTREAM. Shapes and colours must not collide with config/suggestions.json; a test checks. Credit and licence are shown to the parent and repeated in NOTICE.

apps.title: Colouring
apps.blurb: Pick a picture and colour it in, or start on a blank page.
apps.credit: Derived from Kids Coloring by oh-namgyu

apps.title: Studio
apps.blurb: Design and print stickers, labels, diaries and more. For older children.

apps.title: Keyboard
apps.blurb: Press any key and something happens.

apps.title: First Games
apps.blurb: Counting, colours, shapes and animals. No reading needed.
